description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarFeed module in SuiteCRM, verifying the behavior of the SugarFeed class and related functions using the PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: SugarFeedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the SugarFeed module extending the base PHPUnit framework test case.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializing global variables and configuration.

methods.name: testSugarFeed
methods.description: Tests instantiation and basic attributes of the SugarFeed object.

methods.name: testactivateAndDisableModuleFeed
methods.description: Tests activation and disabling of module feeds via static methods.

methods.name: testflushBackendCache
methods.description: Verifies that the flushBackendCache method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testgetModuleFeedFiles
methods.description: Checks retrieval of module feed files for both invalid and valid modules.

methods.name: testgetActiveFeedModules
methods.description: Verifies the list of active feed modules.

methods.name: testgetAllFeedModules
methods.description: Verifies the list of all feed modules.

methods.name: testpushFeed2
methods.description: Tests creating a feed entry related to a Lead and then deletes it.

methods.name: testpushFeed
methods.description: Tests pushing a feed message and retrieving the associated record.

methods.name: fetchReplies
methods.description: Tests fetching replies for a SugarFeed record.

methods.name: testgetLinkTypes
methods.description: Verifies the available link types for feeds.

methods.name: testgetLinkClass
methods.description: Tests retrieval of link handler classes for different link types.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Verifies that get_list_view_data returns an array.

methods.name: testgetTimeLapse
methods.description: Tests the time lapse calculation from a timestamp.

methods.name: testparseMessage
methods.description: Verifies message parsing, especially link embedding in text.
